# Vendored QR encoder

`qrcode-generator-1.4.4.js` is the unmodified `qrcode.js` file from
[`qrcode-generator` 1.4.4](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator), authored by
Kazuhiko Arase and distributed under the MIT License. The source file retains its
copyright and license header.

The complete license text is stored in `LICENSE.qrcode-generator.txt`.

The file is embedded into generated private Shadowrocket import HTML so the import
page can work offline without a CDN or local web server. Generated import artifacts
are private runtime output and are not part of the tracked product source.
